runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: omp plugin link against the generated package with --local, --dry-run, and JSON output from a disposable Git repository.
runtime.permissionProfile: The command was expected to be read-only because --dry-run was set.

assertions.evidence: The command created a user-level plugin symlink and lock entry despite --dry-run.
The plugin was immediately uninstalled; follow-up checks found neither the symlink nor registry references.

limitations: No persistent Oh My Stack plugin state remains after cleanup.
D1 must not pass until an isolated or corrected OMP plugin-manager lifecycle preserves the no-write dry-run invariant.
